text:
zoe: Heads-up — Acme reported large p95 spikes on /v1/rerank during a traffic burst around 2026-03-15T16:12Z. Customers seeing a mix of 504 gateway_timeouts and 502 upstream responses. sample log: "upstream_read_timeout: req=req_0a1b2c host=grpc-rerank-03"
alex: On it, pulling traces + dashboard. do we have request samples?
zoe: pasted a sanitized example below they sent via support ticket: 
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{"query":"best customer support flow","candidates":["A","B","C",...],"top_k":10}'
```
zoe: note: their candidates arrays were large (~400-600 items) and they batch multiple queries per call.
ops-bot: deployment rni-reranker-v2 deployed @ 2026-03-15T15:58Z, autoscale triggered +8 pods between 16:00-16:10Z.
james: I see circuit-breaker events on grpc-rerank-03. retries are configured as 3 attempts with exponential backoff starting 250ms -> 1s. retries + large candidate sizes are causing head-of-line blocking and worker saturation. seen queue_depth peaking at 240.
maya: also seeing heavier KV cache churn for long prompt lengths — colder caches mean higher per-request CPU/GPU time for rerank.
alex: quick mitigation idea: fail-fast for customers exceeding per-request candidate_count > 200 (return 429 with helpful message), and drop retries to 1 for retriable 5xx to avoid retry storms. also route that customer to rni-7b-fallback (lower latency) while we investigate.
zoe: I told Acme the temporary workaround (reduce candidate list to <200, and enable per-request sharding) and they confirmed improvement on their side.
sre-rotation: created incident INC-2026-748 in tracker, assigning to infra/serving for follow-up. ops-bot attached initial graphs (p95, qdepth, error-rate).
james: permanent fixes: add a per-customer concurrency cap, emit metric candidate_count_per_request, tune circuit breaker to open earlier based on queue depth and avg processing time, and add an adaptive backoff policy that fails fast if queue_depth > 100.
maya: also recommend adding a model-variant fallback route (rni-7b-fallback) for customers above a latency threshold so we don't cascade to 5xx.
alex: short-term deploy plan: 1) reduce retry count to 1 for HTTP 502/504 (canary today) 2) add 429 for candidate_count>200 (config flip) 3) increase worker pool by +20% for rerank service. will monitor p95 and error rate.
zoe: customer notified of escalation and planned mitigations. they appreciate the fast response :thumbsup:
sre-rotation: action items logged: [INC-2026-748] - (a) canary retry change, (b) per-customer concurrency limit, (c) metric + alert for avg candidates/request, (d) postmortem if recurrence within 7 days.
alex: grabbing traces and will post link when ready.
zoe: thanks — keeping this thread as the single source for comms to support and the customer.
